05 / HORIZONS / MATURITY / PROVENANCE / DIRECTION

The whole horizon, with its boundaries visible.

Current implementation, technical lineage, research, future direction, and historical identity are kept distinct. Architecture may describe the destination; evidence defines the present boundary.

CURRENT HIERARCHY

Current hierarchy

Asentxia Systems develops DCA. Continuum is its flagship implementation for VERAs. The Regency is the governance and organizational product. The current launch evidence supports one bounded Continuum persistence slice, not a completed end-to-end architecture.

  • DCAReference architecture
  • ContinuumFlagship implementation
  • VERAPersistent principal
  • The RegencyGovernance product

MATURITY VOCABULARY

Maturity vocabulary

Verified means bounded behavior under stated conditions. Tested implementation has a working test surface without a completed integrated claim. Integration means interfaces are being connected. Research describes architecture or investigation. Corrective means an open audit or failure gate remains.

No lineage component is described as integrated until its interface, provenance, positive and negative verification, trust boundaries, end-to-end trace, and evidence record are approved.

HISTORICAL AND FUTURE

Historical and future

FLOKS / floks-pc is historical Continuum environment lineage and a retired product identity. AEON Program remains optional. Xentispace is an identity/network R&D direction. APEX / Agentsea and SPX402 are future or supporting directions. None is a competing current flagship.

Portfolio inclusion alone is not an operational, security, performance, or availability claim.

RESEARCH PROVENANCE

Research provenance

Organization-Invariant Authority for Self-Reorganizing Agent Systems is research lineage for Regency Core and DCA Authority. The paper’s versioned scope does not establish a complete Regency product.
